slide1.headline: US Pulls Back on AI Chip Regulation
slide1.subtitle: A Shift in Policy

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 15 Mar 2026
The US has pulled back a draft regulation targeting global AI chip shipments
The regulation aimed to control the export of AI chips to certain countries
The move is seen as a significant shift in the US's approach to AI chip regulation
This decision may impact the global AI chip market, with potential effects on companies like Google and its recent Wiz acquisition

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The US's decision to pull back on regulation may have far-reaching implications
For the development and export of AI chips, as well as the companies involved
The global AI chip market is expected to continue growing, with a potential value of over $100 billion
Source: PYMNTS.com, 15 Mar 2026
